# Wyatt Au — site intelligence

Personal intelligence dashboard and portfolio site of Wyatt Au: real-time
market data, OSINT feeds (earthquakes, space weather, launches), 16
Rust/WASM quantitative widgets, and an interactive guestbook. All
computation is client-side WebAssembly; public data APIs are keyless and
edge-cached.

Key pages: [World Monitor](https://wyattau.com/world),
[ETF Intelligence](https://wyattau.com/etf),
[ML Benchmarks](https://wyattau.com/ml),
[Docs](https://wyattau.com/docs).

Contact: wyatt_au@protonmail.com
